references.text: The Lord had driven out the Amorites before Israel, and this verse confirms that God gave the land to His people.
Moses warns Israel not to think they have earned the land because of their own righteousness; it is the Lord who drives out the nations.
The historical account of how Israel defeated Sihon, king of the Amorites, and took possession of his land.
Joshua reminds the people that God brought them into the land of the Amorites and gave them victory over them.
The psalmist confirms that it was God's hand that drove out the nations and planted Israel in the land, not their own sword.
Explains that the Lord drives out the nations because of their abominations, providing context for why the Amorites were driven out.
